onboarding.cameraBody: GPS is written into the photo the moment you take it — that stamp is the proof a forager was really standing there.

onboarding.cameraTitle: A tree only counts if you photograph it
onboarding.headline: Nothing ripe should rot.
onboarding.intro: Free, public, edible trees exist all over this city. Free Fruits maps them, proves them, and rewards the people who find them.
onboarding.locationBody: Location powers distances, the 25 m check-in radius, and the nudge when you pass an unverified tree.
onboarding.locationRefusedTitle: You can still read the map
onboarding.locationRow1Body: We never track you in the background.
onboarding.locationRow1Title: Only while the app is open
onboarding.locationRow2Body: Only the trees you log or confirm are.
onboarding.locationRow2Title: Your live position is never stored
onboarding.locationRow3Body: The map still works — you just cannot log or check in.
onboarding.locationRow3Title: You can turn it off any time
onboarding.locationTitle: The map needs to know where you stand
onboarding.notificationsBody: A short nudge when a pin near you clears pending, or when something within 500 m comes into season.
onboarding.notificationsTitle: Get told when the fruit is ready
onboarding.permissionFootnote: You can always change this later in your device Settings.
onboarding.refusalCheckinBody: We cannot tell you are within 25 m of the trunk.
onboarding.refusalLoggingBody: The photo cannot prove anything without a location, so the pin is refused.
onboarding.rule1Body: Open the map and see what is edible nearby, ranked by rarity and distance.
onboarding.rule2Body: Photograph it on site — the GPS stamp is what makes the pin trustworthy.
onboarding.rule3Body: Two foragers confirm it, and the points are yours, permanently.

success.bodyCommunityCheck: Two on-site confirmations turn this from pending to verified. You keep permanent credit either way.
success.bodyDuplicateReview: A finder and two nearby foragers will review the claim. Points land once it is resolved.

noLocation.body: A tree only counts as proof when its photo carries a GPS stamp. Take a new photo on site instead of picking one from your library.
noLocation.title: This photo has no location in it

sendFailure.body: Points stay pending either way — two on-site confirmations still decide.
sendFailure.intro: The photo, GPS stamp, and species are held on your device and will upload the moment you have signal again.
sendFailure.title: The tree is safe on your phone

queued.body: The photo, GPS stamp, and species are saved on your device. It sends itself the moment you have signal — no need to open the app again.

queue.expiredBody: It sat offline for more than 7 days, so the pin could no longer be trusted. Log it again if it is still there.
queue.duplicateTitle: A queued tree matched an existing pin
queue.duplicateBody: It landed near an already-mapped tree once it reached the server — open it to confirm or claim it as separate.
